findings.reason: §3 must be restated to test the already-landed spline-restricted minimum and its residual, or collapsed, instead of designing a move against a deleted function.
findings.text: §3 names `connectivity_boundary.py _refine_wall_minimum_position` as the local-sub-panel limiter refinement to move onto the spline, but that symbol does not exist: 9165374a8 ("unify reachable wall spline authority", 2026-09-04) deleted it and minimises signed normalised flux on knot-split reachable-wall segments off the one tensor spline (nova/equilibrium/connectivity_boundary.py:42, :1037 "Polish a wall candidate on the tensor spline over reachable wall pieces"). The section proposes a move that is already the state of the code.

findings.reason: read-repair work must be aimed at the contour-tree owner that now exists, or explicitly recorded as retired by it, or the plan designs against code it intends to replace.
findings.text: §3/§4 (limiter capture, no_qualified_axis on the hex oracle) escape their read repairs to nova/equilibrium/topology.py, yet the plan's own lead decision of 2026-10-01 says the remaining read waits on plan contour-tree-topology-authority — and that authority already exists in the tree as nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py (raw-flux, hex-carrier, no raster, matches nothing-rasterised decision) with nova/equilibrium/contour_tree_mesh.py. The sections are written against the superseded owner.

findings.reason: three producers re-deriving fields the read already owns forks the bank from the null identification authority the plan is named for; the plan should extend the receipt owner and have the producers serialise it.
findings.text: §1 extends three separate producers (efit_topology_corroboration.py, efit_reproduction_gate.py with diiid_forward_gs_match.py, solovev_certificate.py) so each records Nova's axis and X-point positions, flux, admitted-candidate count and second-best margin. Those nulls are already produced by the single read: ForwardTopologyState carries axis, axis_flux, x_point and x_point_flux (nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:722–730), and the candidate count/margin come off the census receipt (nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:1031 census_stationary_receipt, which already emits multiplicity and value evidence).

findings.reason: the section must account for the added interface surface in its own text before it is implemented; a banked field added three times is added surface with no retirement named.
findings.text: public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the §1 done-when regenerates three receipts "with the new fields", adding axis, saddle, candidate count, second-best margin and read-status/exception fields to three public receipt shapes, and no section names what it retires or merges, or states why nothing can be.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the substantive new surface is the containment-aware read behind Topology.read_qualification (nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1125), which hides census, containment, class read and polish behind one TopologyQualification rather than spreading faces.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §1 has three producers each record the nulls that nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:722 ForwardTopologyState already carries; the owner to extend is named instead of the read re-emitted three ways.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §1 adds axis/saddle/candidate fields across three producer receipts and names nothing it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §3/§4 design read repairs against nova/equilibrium/topology.py while the successor authority the plan itself defers to, nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py, already exists in the tree (added e403c009f).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section proposes a wrapper over existing machinery without justification; §5 merges three reads into one shared read rather than layering a fourth.
